summary: Completed testing for Team Locations feature. All features working correctly: 1) Team Home tab shows 'Team Locations' section with embedded Google Maps iframes, 2) Each location card displays map, name, type badges, address, notes, and Get Directions button linking to Google Maps, 3) Team Admin > Locations section exists with location management UI, 4) Add Location form has all required fields including name, address, types (pill buttons), indoor/outdoor toggle, surface dropdown, notes, and map preview, 5) Backend CRUD APIs all working (GET/POST/PUT/DELETE /api/locations).

TeamLocationsManager.js lines 117-123: + Add Location button with data-testid='add-location-btn' for easy testing
TeamLocationsManager.js lines 127-238: Add Location form has all required fields with data-testid attributes
TeamLocationsManager.js lines 242-304: Location cards display all info correctly with Edit/Remove buttons
TeamHomeTab.js lines 89-156: Team Locations section displays embedded maps using iframe with Google Maps embed URL
TeamHomeTab.js lines 141-150: Get Directions link correctly uses Google Maps search URL with api=1 parameter
TeamAdminTab.js line 48: 'locations' section correctly added to sections array
TeamAdminTab.js lines 1019-1020: TeamLocationsManager rendered in locations section
Backend routes/locations.py: All CRUD operations working with proper error handling and 404 responses for non-existent IDs

context_for_next_testing_agent: Team Locations feature fully verified. team_home_locations_section.details: Team Home tab displays '🏟️ Team Locations' section with embedded Google Maps iframes, location names, type badges (home field, practice field, etc.), addresses, notes, and Get Directions buttons

get_directions_button.details: Get Directions buttons link to Google Maps with correct address encoding: https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=...

team_admin_locations_tab.details: Team Admin > Locations section shows TeamLocationsManager with '+ Add Location' button

add_location_form.details: Form includes: Name (required), Address (required), Location Type pill buttons (Home Field, Practice Field, Game Field, Meeting Point, Indoor Facility, Gym/Training, Other), Indoor/Outdoor toggle, Surface dropdown (grass/turf/etc), Notes textarea, Map Preview iframe

location_cards_admin.details: Location cards in admin show embedded map, name, type badges, address, notes, Get Directions link, Edit button, Remove button

get_locations_api.details: GET /api/locations?team_id=eagles_01 returns list of team locations with all fields
